---
title: "Interactive temperature plot review"
format: html
---

This standalone review document renders the same interactive Plotly figure used by the production dashboard. It uses the existing pooled-hourly historical bands and mean, completed current-year daily ranges, and heat/cold record markers.

The native Plotly version keeps a concise legend. A trial `ggplotly()` conversion retained the data layers but dropped the static plot's hand-placed legend labels and produced unnamed traces and numeric date hover labels.

```{r}
#| echo: false
library(tidyverse)
library(targets)
source("R/functions.R")

tar_load(history_with_calendar)
tar_load(this_year)
tar_load(new_records)

make_interactive_temperature_plot(history_with_calendar, this_year, new_records)
```
